title: Booking Desk Guidance — One Northgate Tire Center Package per Vehicle
content:
# One package per vehicle

At the Northgate Tire Center a new set may not be booked for a vehicle that already has a package whose status is awaiting installation. A vehicle may carry an installed package and a newly booked one only until the new set is installed: when the new set replaces every tire of the earlier set, the earlier package is retired on the new installation date; when it replaces only some, the replaced tires leave the earlier package's coverage and the others stay covered by it. Road hazard replacements, rotations and treadwear claims are counted across the whole package, not per tire, and a replacement tire stays on the package it replaced into.

## What the booking rule looks at

The bar on a new booking is read from the system's package records, not from what the member says: the member, the vehicle described on the package, and the package's status. A package of the **same member** for the **same vehicle** in **awaiting installation** status blocks a new set for that vehicle. The rule turns on the vehicle and the status only, so a request for another tire size or another appointment date for that vehicle is still a new set for it.

| Existing package of this member on this vehicle | New set for the vehicle |
|---|---|
| Awaiting installation | may not be booked |
| Installed | may be booked; the vehicle carries both packages until the new set is installed |

## When the new set is installed

| New set replaces | Earlier package |
|---|---|
| every tire of the earlier set | retired on the new installation date |
| only some of the earlier tires | the replaced tires leave its coverage; the other tires stay covered by it |

## Counting across the package

Road hazard replacements, rotations and treadwear claims are counted for the package as a whole, never tire by tire. A tire fitted as a replacement belongs to the package it was replaced into.

**Hypothetical case.** A vehicle has an installed four-tire package, and the member books two new tires for the front axle. Once the two are installed, the two front tires leave the earlier package's coverage and the two rear tires remain covered by it; the earlier package is not retired, because the new set did not replace every tire.
